login_screen.scroll_hint: New here? Learn how it works
login_screen.what_is_p1: MorningBriefing.AI is a personal dashboard that gathers your day — weather, stocks, news, trends, calendar, health, and a private diary — into a single screen and an AI-written morning briefing tailored to your interests. Instead of checking a dozen apps, you open one tab and see what actually matters to you.
login_screen.what_is_p2: It works as both a web app and a Chrome new-tab extension, so your briefing can greet you every time you open your browser.
login_screen.step1_d: Click “Continue with Google” above. Your account keeps your settings and data private to you.
login_screen.step2_d: A quick onboarding lets you pick interest categories and a briefing tone so your content feels personal from day one.
login_screen.step3_d: Allow Google Calendar and Fitness access to power the schedule and health widgets. You can skip this and add it later.
login_screen.step4_d: Your personalized dashboard appears. Read the AI briefing, then browse the weather, news, stocks, and other widgets.
login_screen.f_briefing_d: A short, narrated summary of your morning — schedule, weather, news, and more in one read.
login_screen.f_weather_d: Current conditions, humidity, precipitation, and air quality. Toggle between °C and °F.
login_screen.f_stocks_d: Major indices at a glance plus any tickers you add yourself.
login_screen.f_news_d: Personalized headlines based on your interests, alongside real-time trending topics.
login_screen.f_calendar_d: Today's events and to-dos. Connect Google Calendar to sync automatically.
login_screen.f_health_d: Steps, sleep, and calories. Connect Google Fit to see your real activity.
login_screen.f_diary_d: A daily question and a private, PIN-protected diary that the AI can help you write.
login_screen.f_smart_d: Add any keyword — a brand, hobby, or person — and get a widget that tracks it for you.
login_screen.yours_1: Drag and drop widgets to rearrange your layout.
login_screen.yours_2: Refresh any widget on its own with its refresh icon.
login_screen.yours_3: Open Settings to change theme, clock style, temperature units, stock tickers, and your diary PIN.
login_screen.yours_4: Add Smart Widgets for any keyword you want to keep an eye on.
login_screen.yours_5: Switch between English and Korean any time from the top bar.
login_screen.notice_title: First sign-in: a Google notice you can safely pass
login_screen.notice_p1_pre: This is a student project that hasn't gone through Google's app verification, so on your first sign-in Google shows a
login_screen.notice_p2_post: . It's a standard policy gate for unverified apps, not a sign of any problem with the app or your account.
login_screen.footer: MorningBriefing.AI · Built with React, Vite & Supabase

diary_encryption.title: End-to-end diary encryption
diary_encryption.intro: Encrypt your diary text in this browser before it is saved, so the server only stores ciphertext.
diary_encryption.intro_ai: AI features (diary generation, rewriting) still send diary text to the AI service while they process it.
diary_encryption.intro_pin: The 4-digit PIN is a separate screen lock and does not encrypt anything.
diary_encryption.intro_personalization: While encryption is on, keywords are not extracted from your diary or answers for personalization.
